name: Oklahoma Natural Gas
notes: Researched from public oklahomanaturalgas.com pages only. Sign-in uses a Username and Password (Forgot Username / Forgot Password links on the public sign-in form). Guest Payment finds the account by phone number or service address (address lookup is not expressible; phone used). Automatic Payment drafts on the bill due date; eligibility text says a U.S. checking or savings account while the update steps mention cards, so methodTypes is bank only. Enroll/unenroll with the Automatic Payment toggle (NEXT/ENROLL, UNENROLL). E-Statements toggle on the account home. Payment arrangements online via Make Payment > Make Payment Arrangement for accounts with a balance due. Stop service via Schedule Service > Start, Stop or Transfer. Saved methods: one bank account or up to five cards. Online payment fees are not published, so fees are left out. A deposit waived for AutoPay/e-statements may be reassessed if unenrolled within 12 cycles (not expressible). Future-dated one-time payments are not described (family default kept). Reviewer: guest-pay note and help mention only the phone lookup the mock accepts (the real Guest Payment also accepts a service address).

guest_pay.note: Find your account with the phone number on the account. Log out of your online account before making a guest payment.

autopay_cancel.note: Click the Automatic Payment toggle and choose UNENROLL. You can also call 800-664-5463 and press 0.

payment_arrangement.note: Available for accounts with a balance due. Installments appear as a separate line on your bill with no penalty or finance charge.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Log in and choose Make Payment, or use Guest Payment to pay without logging in by finding the account with the phone number on the account. The free app also lets you pay and manage saved payment methods.

By phone, call 800-664-5463 and follow the prompts. By mail, send the bill stub and a check with your account number written on it to Oklahoma Natural Gas, P.O. Box 25030, Oklahoma City, OK 73125-5030. More than 500 authorized pay agents, drop boxes and kiosks also take payments; a provider fee may apply and posting can take several days.
Only pay through the official website, app or authorized locations; unauthorized third-party payment sites are not affiliated with us.

help.title: Automatic Payment
paragraphs: Automatic Payment drafts your bill from a U.S. checking or savings account on the due date at no extra cost. Your bill arrives about two weeks before the draft.
To enroll, log in, click the toggle next to Automatic Payment, complete the form, click NEXT, confirm and click ENROLL. To stop, click the toggle and choose UNENROLL, or call 800-664-5463.
If a deposit was waived because you enrolled, unenrolling before 12 consecutive billing cycles may mean the deposit is charged again.

help.title: E-Statements
paragraphs: Turn E-Statements on or off with the toggle on your account home after logging in; turning it off asks you to confirm. Manage the email used for e-statements under Contact Preferences.

help.title: Assistance programs
paragraphs: Payment Arrangements for a balance due can be set up online at any time through your account. The Average Payment Plan spreads gas costs over 12 months.

Share The Warmth, funded by customers and the company, helps families with an immediate financial emergency. LIHEAP applications go through the Oklahoma Department of Human Services, and 2-1-1 Oklahoma refers you to other local help.

help.title: Start, stop or transfer service
paragraphs: Use Schedule Service, then Start, Stop or Transfer, to request a stop online. Customer service is available at 800-664-5463, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central.

extra.intent: Using the Oklahoma Natural Gas (ONG) help pages, find how many credit or debit cards can be saved to an online account. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Up to 5 cards (and one bank account).

extra.intent: Using the Oklahoma Natural Gas (ONG) help pages, find on which day Automatic Payment drafts the bill. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: It drafts on the due date of the bill.
